batting.dismissal: c Sohail Tanvir b MM Patel

batting.name: MS Dhoni
batting.dismissal: c GC Smith b SK Warne

batting.name: Joginder Sharma
batting.dismissal: c Sohail Tanvir b MM Patel

batting.name: SA Asnodkar
batting.dismissal: c M Ntini b S Vidyut

batting.name: YK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b M Muralitharan

balls.text: and he gets six! Ntini is bowled making room and Tanvir finishes with the best figures in any format of Twenty20 cricket, would you believe? He gets 6 for 14!
comes down again and connects well, slashing past backward point
shot! Ntini uses his feet and drives that very hard past the gap at cover
slower one, looped up wide, Ntini slashes and just gets the toe end of the bat on it and it flies down to Trivedi at third man, who dives but cant stop it
another attempted yorker on leg stump, Gony carves it down to mid-on
yorker down the pads, Gony backs away and ball just misses leg stump
slow short one to finish off, Ntini just gets the head and bat outside the line
full this time, Ntini slashes and misses, Rawat takes and appeals but there was no bat on that one
short again and now he goes wafting, but just misses out on it
another short ball, this time outside off, and Ntini ducks under it
short again, down leg stump, Ntini sways away and the wide is called
short again, rearing into him as he takes his eyes off it, just managing to play it down near his feet
short ball to Ntini, who gets onto the haunches to let it go by
not yet, as the full toss it played off the pads to midwicket for one
slips in the slower one, it swings in and beats his front-foot drive
and there are the best figures of the IPL! Tanvir gets a five-wicket haul, keeping it straight to go past Murali's swipe and rattling the stumps
short and he goes pulling, inside-edging in front of the wicketkeeper
lovely yorker on the pads, Murali pushes to point and scampers off, gets sent back and just manages to make his ground
and another wicket for him first ball, landing on a length, swinging in the slower ball, and Morkel loses his stumps as he misses out on an ugly heave across the line
goes carving outside off stump and nearly drags onto this stumps
full outside off and he carves it into the ground in front of extra cover
bounces him over the stumps and Morkel ducks under it
slower ball beats him as he heaves across the line and misses
short and he flat-bats it over square leg, Smith runs across and slides on the ropes to keep them down to two
sees the width and slashes upwards of point, it drops safely in the deep
short to welcome him and he hops back, running it to backward point
and he departs first ball, cramped as he tries to swipe a short ball over midwicket but ends up giving mid-on catching practice, and thats two in the over for Munaf
slower ball, full and wide, he reaches out and runs it to short third
well stopped, as Morkel heaves across the line and Kaif comes sprinting and diving across down near long-on to save four, great fielding there
Raina goes slogging Munaf up over extra cover, the ball stays up in the air for a week but settles down into Tanvir's hands at long-off
overpitched on off stump and Morkel slashes it through extra cover
fullish on off stump and thats driven past the bowler to long-on
short and wide but he cant put it away, instead chopping to short cover
slower ends up a low full toss on middle and leg and Raina uses his feet, driving wide of mid-on for a single
gets some width and chops it wide of Kaif at backward point
slower ball, short and sits up to surprise Morkel, who gets back on one leg to pull but has to adjust and play it back to the bowler as it didn't come on as expected
tidy start, on the stumps and he just plays it back to Trivedi
flat down the pads, he shuffles and misses, and the ball nearly hits leg
flat on middle and leg, another shuffle and drive wide of midwicket
again its flat on the stumps and he tucks it to midwicket
flatter on middle and leg, he gets back and drives past midwicket
shot! Morkel eases back and waits, then opens the face of the bat and uses the pace of the ball to steer it wide of short third man, well done there
back of a length on the pads and he nudges it down to fine leg
quicker and flatter, he shuffles and muscles it past midwicket
four more, as he slogs from off stump into the yawning gap at square leg
good blow, Morkel skipping down and clubbing it very, very straight for six
quicker one, he gets across but cannot beat backward point
and thats got to hurt, as Morkel follows up with a slog-sweep past square leg
oh man, he's dropped a sitter! Raina skips down and hits the ball straight to Pathan at long-on, who doesn't have to move at all but cups his hands in front of his face and allows the ball to pop out
slides into Morkel, who turns it away straight to midwicket
flighted this time on off stump, he gets forward and pushes to cover
flatter one, no spin at all, Morkel gets back and can only drive it back
quicker one, pinning Morkel back in his crease, defended back again
some turn now, he gets back and punches the ball towards mid-on
flat on middle and off and watchfully defended back to Pathan
short again, allowing him to free the arms and cut into the gap at point, the ball races away and evades Jadeja, running around on the ropes
looped up, Raina dances down and flicks that past mid-on nicely
flat outside off, he gets back and flat-bats it back to Warne, who fields
dips in again and he mistimes his front-foot slog toward midwicket
well flighted up, dips nicely and Morkel gets well forward to push to cover
short outside off, spins in but its too wide and he gets back to drive in the air past a diving cover fielder out to the sweeper, who swoops in to cut off the second
back of a length, Raina hops across and eases the ball past point
gets back on the toes and pushes the ball into the gap at cover
again on the stumps and Raina rolls the wrists nicely, into the gap
short of a length on the stumps, Morkel hops up and tucks it to leg
fuller length, he drives but mistimes the shot to the man at mid-off
back of a length outside off, Raina gets back and punches past cover
flighted up wide and Morkel drives past cover, a dive saves four

and its no contest at all! Well bowled, Warne, flummoxing Dhoni with lovely flight and dip, turning it away from middle and leg to suck him forward into a faulty drive,  the outside edge flies to Smith's right at slip but he chases it and snaps it up with those massive buckets
fuller, outside leg, no spin as Dhoni strides forward and defends
well bowled, champ! The Warne special, pitching outside leg stump and ripping across Dhoni, who pushes and misses due to the massive spin, wow
short and wide, Raina reaches out and slaps out to Trivedi again
gently tossed up outside off, no spin, Raina pushes past point and this time he and Dhoni harry across for the second as Trivedi over-runs the ball
shorter one, gentle swing, Dhoni hops across and lets it go again
good length, moving away from Dhoni, who covers off and leaves it be
banged in short, getting him hopping and tapping it to midwicket
good length outside off stump, Raina eases onto the front foot and plays to cover
steps down and takes the ball on the full, driving to mid-on for one
on the stumps, shortish length, easily tucked past square leg and they jog down, clearly not eager on taking the second run
short of a length, Dhoni hops across and pushes the ball to point

caught and bowled! The short ball does the trick, getting it to come on quick to Badrinath, who tries to pull but gets himself into a tangle, the weight not transfered at all, and Watson just stands there and accepts the top edge
slower ball on the stumps, well picked and flicked past midwicket
short and going away, the extra bounce beats him as he tries to cut
back of a length on the stumps, defended back to Watson
good shot, just leaning into the wide one and square-driving it away
mistimed slog, Raina making room and carving the ball over the covers, it drops safely in the deep near the ropes and is easily hauled back in

short again, good bounce, he's cramped as he tries to pull and ends up scooping  it past square leg, the ball runs down to fine leg where Jadeja dives superbly but the ball just rolls past his fingers
back of a length, he's cramped as he drives, inside-edging to fine leg, Rawat runs after it and throws back and some excellent running gets Chennai three
short and sliding into Badri, who tries to pull but cops it in the midriff
short of a length on leg stump, Raina tucks it off the pads for a single
oye, down the pads, he tucks it and gets bat on ball, just evading a diving wicketkeeper, Rawat, and its away for four runs
good length just outside off and he confidently drives to backward point
wrong line, on the pads and thats a confident tuck past midwicket
bouncer, rising on Badri, who hops back and plays if up off the chest
top stuff, right up there on off stump and he defends tightly
slides down leg stump, raps the pad, Munaf appeals but that was slipping down the line, Raina wants one but Badri waves him back, more pressure on Chennai
tidy start, back of a length on off stump and Badri defends to point
lands outside leg stump, raps the pad, and they steal a quick leg-bye
edged and taken! Third wicket for Tanvir, pitching outside the off stump for Vidyut to go flashing, and the thick outside edge is snapped up by Warne at second slip
plays down the wrong line and gets beaten outside off stump
touch fuller and Raina drives off the front foot to cover for one
movement again, swinging away from outside off as Raina leaves
gentle swing after it lands on a good length and its pushed to point
bouncer! Dropped in short over the stumps, Vidyut goes pulling but is beaten by the steepling height and so is the wicketkeeper, so more runs
gets bat on this one, steering it off the back foot to backward point
another peach, this one kicking off the lively pitch, squaring up Vidyut who hangs his bat out and so narrowly ends up getting glove on it, excellent ball
fuller in length, swinging away and thats a tight call for wide
short one now, and he gets back to keep it down in front of point
well bowled, landing it on a length and shaping it away from Vidyut, who is beaten by the angle as he feels for it outside off stump
full on the stumps, swings in and he tucks it off the pads down to fine leg
this one leaves the batsman, who shoulders arms

and he's gone as well! Fantastic start! Tanvir takes out Fleming for a duck as well, pitching outside off stump and striking Fleming marginally outside the line of off stump as he plants the foot out and shapes to play across the line, they all appeal and the umpire raises his finger once more, though this one looked a bit iffy as Fleming had a good stride forward
fullish length outside off stump, Fleming pushes forward and runs the ball straight to the fielder at backward point
first runs, as the ball swings in again and Vidyut nudges to mid-on
good length outside off stump and he watchfully plays it to point

and he strikes first ball! With some swing! Tanvir pitches just outside off stump and brings the ball in exaggeratedly to Patel, who sticks his front foot forward and plays across the line, missing the line, and the umpire raises the finger of fate, looked fairly out to me
thats that, Smith freeing the arms and chipping over mid-off for two
he walks well outside leg stump and cannot pull, instead slapping it to the man at extra cover, had he connected well it was a boundary for sure
tossed up on the stumps and Watson watchfully defends
fuller on off stump, he works it across with an inside-edge
tossed up again outside off, Smith goes heaving and misses
gets some turn from the lovely length, beating Smith's drive
shuffles around, Murali sees him and fires it down leg, then Watson adjusts and tucks it off the pads for a single
flat on off stump, he gets forward and flicks it past midwicket
Vidyut drops short and Watson pulls out to deep midwicket for one
now he fetches the ball from outside off stump and sweeps hard past midwicket with plenty of power for four
skips down, connects the ball on the full and has a free swing of the arms, depositing the ball over long-on for half a dozen, off the mark in style is Watto
tossed up a tad and this time he gets well forward to defend
gets across and cuts the short ball straight to Badrinath at point
flat on the stumps, he gets back and pulls out to deep backward square
he tries to finish this over off with a big hit but doesn't read the delivery and his sweep just balloons up to short fine leg where Raina takes the sitter
flat down leg stump, he tries to sweep but mistimes the shot
down the pads again but this time he gets bat on it, working it fine
wrong line, spinning down leg stump for Dhoni to collect
misreads the doosra, getting across but bringing the bat down very late, lucky for him it pitched well outside the line and he was forward
shorter one spins across him and he misses out on his cut
full and flat middle stump, Smith works it from in front of the pad for two

well caught ... or not! Pathan gets down and swings this one into the air to Ntini, getting across from deep midwicket and holding it on the ropes, but then losing his balance and as he falls over he has to throw the ball back in, so a good effort but no catch
arm ball goes all wrong, sliding well down leg stump for wide
thats massive! Pathan doesn't waste time, stepping out and hammering that with the spin for a big brute of a hit over deep midwicket
tossed up down the pads, Pathan misses out on his sweep
gives this one a tweak but its too straight and Smith shuffles across to turn it away towards short fine leg for one
flat and short, Smith cuts down to the fielder at short third man
and he gets a wicket with a real long hop, which Asnodkar can only pull out to Ntini running in at deep midwicket, and he goes after a sprightly knock
fraction short outside off, Asnodkar waits on the back foot and then late-cuts it wide of backward point for a single
flatter outside leg stump and he taps it to forward short leg

quicker through the air, he shapes to on-drive but the doosra gets him confused, there's an inside-edge into the covers and he is so, so quick between the wickets, sprinting back to the danger end for the second
flighted up on a length, and he uneasily defends it back

pushed through Asnodkar, almost falling over as he misses the drive, Dhoni collects and breaks the stumps with the batsman's back leg just back on the ground, that was touch and go but replays were correct
flat on off stump, he dabs it to cover and Asnodkar calls him over
too short but thats a stunning shot, Asnodkar backing away and punching up over the covers for a one-bounce four
down the pads and this time he sweeps out to deep fine leg
flat down leg stump, he shapes to on-drive but the leading-edge pops up to the off side, dropping safely
flat outside off stump, Asnodkar pushes off the front foot to cover
pushed down Smith's pads, he tucks it down to square leg
short on the stumps, he backs away and cuts past point for one
looped up outside leg stump, he's late on the attempted flick
pitches outside leg, clips Smith's pad and runs to slip
flighted outside leg stump, Smith tries to paddle-sweep but cant get bat on it before the doosra spins past Dhoni for wides
spins into him, he backs away and cuts the offbreak to cover
spun across Smith, who pushes off the front foot and edges to gully
gets back and cuts against the turn, placing it wide of backward point
flighted up outside off, he strides well forward and mistimes the shot
rubbish bowling from Morkel, again pitching full down the pads, ball clips Smith's pads and beats Dhoni, dribbling down to the fine-leg boundary
backs away to leg, skips down and misses out on the shot, the ball gets lodged between his thighs, it drops to the ground and Morkel comes forward to collect
another wide, just sliding down Smith's pads, this time Dhoni collects
wide, down leg stump, evades bat and keeper and runs to fine leg
change of pace, slants into him, he plays it late down to gully
another bouncer over Asnodkar, wide called for height
another short one, this time on the body, gets him hopping in his crease and playing it down with one hand to square leg
thats bounced in short, Asnodkar hops up and tries to uppercut, but cannot connect on that one that was way over his head
lands on a good length, he waits and taps it to backward point
comes down first ball, isn't to the pitch, and pushes uppishly to mid-off
fuller length, Smith looks at on-driving but adjusts to push to extra cover
thats overpitched pretty wide of off stump, miles away from Smith's bat
sits up on him, Smith doesn't time it off the middle but gets enough on the short ball to swing it down into the gap between square leg and midwicket
slower ball on middle and leg, he shuffles and turns it to square leg
back of a length, he gets back and plays the ball to backward point
edged wide of slip, as Asnodkar slashes hard off the front foot and evades the fielders, the ball speeding away, he was nowhere near the pitch of the ball
makes room, skips aside, and slaps that firmly past cover and point
bang, thats four! Smith latches onto the short ball and pulls past midwicket
another attempted cut, another cramped shot, and the ball rolls to slip
short and wide, he eases back and cuts but cannot connect
full on the stumps, he drives hard and gets an inside-edge onto the boot

short of a length, he gets back and cuts late, Asnodkar was off and Smith was uncertain about the run as Badrinath swooped in from point, but follows through with the run as he sees his partner harrying down
lucky! Asnodkar, a little batsman, goes pulling the short-pitched ball and gets a thick top-edge over Dhoni and slip that flies down to the ropes
thats a firm shot, Asnodkar dragging from outside off stump down into the gap at midwicket, the fast outfield escorts the ball away for four
comes onto the front foot and slashes a good-length ball to point
gets over the short one and runs it down past gully for one
slides down the pads, he misses out, Smith calls for one as he sees the ball drop near Asnodkar's pads, there's nearly a collision as batsmen, bower and wicketkeeper all mesh
back of a length outside off and he plays it down to backward point
full on the pads and Asnodkar tucks it to midwicket for one

oh thats another dolly gone missing, this time from Chennai! Smith gets back and makes a meal of a pull, the ball again coming onto him too fast, the ball just gently lobs up into the air to midwicket but its Joginder Sharma who lets Smith off, running in from mid-on and letting the ball in and out of his palms ... really easy catch, Smith was walking back to the pavilion
solid comeback, pitching on a length and drawing a forward defensive
biffed! Smith takes a few steps down and greets his South African team-mate on the full and creams him powerfully through the covers for four
quick stuff, slanting into Asnodkar's pads, he tries to nudge it away but gets a leg-bye to the off side and runs off after Smith urges the single
good movement, pushed across Smith, who manages to dab past gully
short of a length on the stumps and Smith gets across to tuck it fine
nips in off a length, he opens the face and runs it wide of point
short again and he bottom-edges the pull to Patel at square leg
sees a short one and mistimes the pull, instead flat-batting it down the ground and it bounces a couple feet in front of Muralitharan at mid-off
beaten, as he flashes from the crease and is very late on the shot
and he's welcomed with utter disdain, Asnodkar clearing the front foot and hammering him ever so hard over his head for a dead straight boundary
back of a length, he gets across and defends it to cover
extra carry now, as this one slants across from Smith, shouldering arms
well bowled, back of a length and Smith watchfully defends it back
fuller outside off stump and thats a pleasing drive to mid-off
pitches outside leg, swings in, and catches him on the hop
beaten there, holding a good line and moving it away from Smith's prod
